title: Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37973v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. translated_title: 合并与分支：面向推荐的高效树状结构大语言模型监督微调
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式推荐需要读取冗长、文本丰富的交互历史，但仅生成简短的语义标识符（SID）。这种不对称性使得监督微调效率低下：编码历史的代价高昂，而每段历史通常只为一个目标提供监督。我们提出 Merge and Branch（M&B）方法，以降低输入成本并从每段已编码的历史中学习更多信息。Merge 将每个历史物品的 SID 和文本压缩为少量可学习的 token；Branch 利用压缩后的历史来预测多个目标 SID。为了在共享历史计算的同时保持这些目标相互独立，M&B 将每个样本组织成一棵浅而宽的树。我们开发了树形 FlashAttention 来高效执行这种布局：共享历史只需处理一次，而梯度从每个分支反向传播，实现端到端训练。树形结构的键/值缓存进一步将历史共享扩展到受限解码阶段。在公开基准上的实验表明……
tldr: 提出 Merge and Branch 方法，通过将历史物品压缩为少量可学习 token，并以浅而宽的树状结构结合树形 FlashAttention 实现历史计算共享与多目标分支预测，大幅降低 LLM 生成式推荐监督微调的输入成本并提升学习效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Merge and Branch, which compresses each historical item into a few learned tokens and organizes examples as shallow, wide trees with tree FlashAttention to share history computation and predict multiple target SIDs, significantly reducing input costs and improving training efficiency for LLM-based generative recommendation.
